verdict.rationale: Readable text was captured from many public GST guidance URLs (gst.gov.in/help/helpmodules, /help/registration, the homepage), which indicates the pages serve keyless HTML content. The probe also contrasts the GST portal's 'readable pages' with the income-tax portal's JavaScript-only app shell. missing for 10: a direct probe of gst.gov.in recording HTTP status and the identified user agent used, explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot wall appears across the help pages, and substantive readable content from the developer portal (only its navigation text was captured).
